dialoguesToLoad.text: This made me break a sweat... Thanks for the assist! I mean... I thank you for your service to the crown.
It is fine, Renovatio. You're amongst friends.
Really? Talking all princely talk is exhausting... Who are your friends, Gale?
I'm Zack Farron, this is Kira Albarn. And who are you?
This is Prince Renovatio, heir to the crown of Archades.
Albarn, is that right?
So what?
Anyway, it's not Prince Renovatio anymore. Father passed away earlier today.
Really?! So... You are finally king, Reno!
Yes, finally.
Hold on, your king just died and that's your reaction? What's wrong with you guys?
It's... Complicated.
The previous king was a mad coward. He has been doing everything in his power to crush Occidens.
Father was way too afraid of the old world machines you guys fancy so much.
About that, Renovatio, we need your authorization to access the Junkyard.
The junkyard? Are you looking for something?
Yeah, something that was stolen from a friend of ours and then the army stole it from the thieves, it's complicated.
I see, then you have my blessing. After all, you just saved the King.
We did, yeah. I hope we won't come to regret it.
Kira Albarn... Your tongue is as sharp as your eyes. I like that.
That's not going to get you anywhere.
You never know...
Right...
Your Majesty, perhaps now is not the best time to flirt.
Right. My apologies. You know I can't help it...
Then let us leave it at that.
Right. I have a lot on my plate, with this war and everything.
We'll take our leave, then. See you!
